question: Step 2's P5 failed: 36 of 3,000 fuzzed calls threw, though the mutation gate was clean. The cause, found after the receipt was kept: problems() calls .includes on a persona's forbidden list without checking that it is a list (a number, true or an object there throws). Once that one line is fixed, is the fence total, on the same fuzz and on a fresh one, with nothing else changed?
fix: src/roster.mjs problems(): read a persona's forbidden list only when it is a list, as may() already does. A test with forbidden set to a number, true and an object is added first.

claims.claim: Step 2's own fuzz (seed 2026, 3,000 calls to problems, toolOf and may) on the fixed kernel: nothing throws and may() says yes to no unknown persona or tool.
A fresh fuzz the kernel has never met (seed 2027, 3,000 calls, same generator): nothing throws, no yes to an unknown.
The fix changes nothing else: P1, P2, P3, P4 and P6 measured on the fixed kernel give exactly step 2's results.
The fixed roster.mjs stays mutation-clean under witness v0.6, nothing baselined.
